notes: 🦴 A fossil was serving stale share history forever. In saved-data mode the app skipped refreshing a share’s history if it was fresh — OR if no data key was entered. That second condition dated from the era when no key meant no live route; keys were removed long ago, so it short-circuited the freshness check on every device and history could sit weeks old, silently, while prices stayed current. Removed: history older than 6 days now refreshes itself from your server store the moment you open it.
